explanation: Write r=6λ. The repeated characteristic root gives y=(A+Bx)e^{rx}. The boundary conditions imply rA+B=0 and (1+2r)A+(3+2r)B=0. A nontrivial solution requires 2r²+r-1=(r+1)(2r-1)=0. Thus λ=-1/6 or 1/12. Respectively, A=B or A=-2B, giving Be^{-x}(x+1) and Ce^{x/2}(x-2), with nonzero constants.
